data.name: Ilmeeyat
data.gender_notes: Ilmeeyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ilm' meaning knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Ilmeeyat represents wisdom, insight, and enlightenment. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding in life. The name Ilmeeyat carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ilmeeyat usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Ilmeeyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilmeeyat total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
